title: lucent.json
description: What a Lucent package's platform code needs from the app that installs it. It sits next to the package's package.json. The app's build merges it with its other Lucent packages'; two packages that disagree on a value fail the build.

pods.description: CocoaPods the native package depends on: pod name → version requirement, as in a Podfile ("~> 1.0"). Their frameworks can be imported from lucent:ios/* once installed.

infoPlist.description: Info.plist entries: key → string value. The Expo config plugin adds them unless the app sets the key itself; for bare apps, lucent build names the keys the app's Info.plist lacks.

dependencies.description: Gradle artifacts: "group:artifact" → version. They become api dependencies of the native package, so lucent:android/* can import their classes.

permissions.description: Android permissions for the manifest, such as "android.permission.CAMERA". Permissions the SDK methods you call require are added without listing them here.
